title: The Gun Markets of Pakistan with Suroosh Alvi
summary: A VICE report from 2011 in which Suroosh Alvi revisits the gun markets in Pakistan's tribal areas, a stronghold of the Taliban. It shows weapons being made and sold by hand and a country described as a powder keg.
why: HN uses it as a visual reference for hand-built firearms and craft gunsmithing, especially in threads on 3D-printed and home-made guns.

quote.text: VICE video from 2011 on the same gun markets of Pakistan, I started following VICE after I saw that video.
